channel.title: Fort Worth Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fort Worth Magazine (fwtx.com)

item.title: My Night With Robert Duvall at Dickies Arena
item.description: The Lonesome Dove star, forever Gus McCrae in Texas lore, once slipped quietly into Dickies Arena to honor his friend Buster Welch — and I sat down beside him.

item.title: Jesse Jackson’s 1984 Fort Worth Stop Echoed His Push for Voting Reform
item.description: The preacher and civil rights leader, who died at 84, drew a standing ovation at Mount Olive Baptist Church while campaigning for the Democratic nomination.

item.title: 6 Questions To Ask Before Hiring a Personal Injury Attorney
item.description: Hiring a personal injury attorney? Ask these 6 key questions about board certification, trial experience, fees and communication before you commit.

item.title: Kelly Clarkson Has a Comic Book, and You Can Read It Here
item.description: The Grammy-winning singer, talk show host, and Burleson native is the newest addition to TidalWave Comics’ Female Force series.

item.title: Brad Sherrod Leaves Texas Wesleyan for Morehouse Head Coaching Job
item.description: The Rams won two SAC titles and reached the NAIA playoffs in each of Sherrod’s two-season tenure.

item.title: John Cornyn, Fort Worth Allies Take Aim at Ken Paxton
item.description: As early voting begins, Sen. John Cornyn and friends, including Charlie Geren, deliver a blunt warning about Ken Paxton’s record while leaning on character, law enforcement endorsements, and a massive fundraising edge.

item.title: A Golden Sibling Among Reining and Cutting — The NRCHA Celebration of Champions
item.description: The NRCHA brings a dynamic infusion of the best of both cow horse worlds to Fort Worth, where big money meets even bigger performances.

item.title: Victor Villarreal Offers Beet Hummus (and More) Below Star Cafe
item.description: The Fort Worth chef has given the basement of a beloved Stockyards restaurant one hell of a makeover.

item.title: Four Courses From The Mont [RECIPES]
item.description: A four-course meal prepared by Michael Duff and Michael Arlt of the New American restaurant in southwest Fort Worth.

item.title: Heritage Brand Brings Hand-Stitched Artistry to the Stockyards
item.description: Known for its one-of-a-kind, luxury Western handbags, Heritage Brand sets up shop in the Stockyards — but only through March 22.
